body:
Part of #289; coordinate #36/#235 and the modal-context comparison in #297. Priority: early capability test, alongside the author-representation comparison. Mode changes and internal setting construction are distinct; success at one does not establish the other.

## Question

Can an author construct a setting from presentation data inside a base language, reason there, and reindex the entire construction when the data changes? A list of externally supplied model instances does not answer this question.

## Acceptance

- Freeze a nonconstant internal presentation P over a context, a setting construction S(P), and a second construction depending on it. Specify the selected argument, dependencies and observations independently of the current encoding. Explain why the example requires internal presentation rather than a renamed external model parameter.
- Compare at least two credible representations, using primary sources where their hypotheses apply. Explicit internal presentation, indexed categorical judgments and mode-indexed syntax may expose different obligations; do not presume MTT or an internal-language theorem solves the setting-construction problem.
- Construct the comparison between building S after substitution and building first then reindexing. Prove its identity/composition coherence for two successive substitutions, including term/type compatibility and selected dependent witnesses. Determine whether the second construction inherits the same laws or introduces an additional admission condition.
- Include a failure case that detects a missing comparison, an illicit context access, or erased promised data. If a modal contract is used, state its context restrictions separately from the internal construction contract. Do not require faithful interpretation where the specified observations deliberately forget information.
- Compare this capability with the proposed author/interpretation/model/comparison responsibilities. Revise their boundaries if the example cannot be expressed without leaking repeated semantic alignment to authors. A replacement may change judgments or context organization; compatibility with today's raw annotations is not an entry condition.
- Deliver a checked specialization and precise interpretation contract, or a concrete failed hypothesis with an owned prerequisite. Separate a proposed higher extension from what this example proves. Feed any new model/morphism requirements back into the structure audit and boundary experiment before architectural adoption.

## Evidence and boundaries

Use `docs/research/dependent-architecture-reassessment.md`, its three independent assessments, #292's report and frozen external memo as starting evidence. Consult primary sources for the claims actually used. These are competing diagnoses and proposals, not new checked theorems. The work is scoped by its mathematical questions, not an arbitrary effort cap. Substantial reconstruction or a different foundation is an allowed outcome; an immediate adapter to current generated annotations is not a condition for investigating it.

Keep object-language identity, judgmental equality, metatheoretic equality and presentation comparisons distinct. State which observations an interpretation preserves; a deliberately lossy interpretation is not invalid merely because it is not faithful. Require exact selected data when the client contract calls for it. Separate model-builder work, ordinary author work and host-language encoding cost.

Persist findings, failed approaches, positive constructions, exact hypotheses and the adopt/investigate/defer/reject decision. New Lean claims require checked specializations, statement review and README's applicable build/exhaustive audit. Research and implementation require independent Standards/Spec review. This issue does not resume #107, select or prepare #108's fresh theorem, activate #260, require a new frontend, or authorize weakening the mathematical acceptance conditions.

## Coordination

Feed capability and comparison requirements into #314/#315; coordinate #297 context restrictions without equating mode changes and internal construction. Discovery need not wait for the existing annotation representation to be repaired.
title: Test internal setting construction under dependent substitution
